fields.summary: TC-LCO-024: LCO Decision Matrix - Flight Number Change - Non-Originals - Involuntary

content.text: Linked Story: LCO Decision Matrix

Precondition: Crew member is non-original on flight 124 HOU-DAL via a prior involuntary event. Change type is Involuntary. Only the flight number changes - all planned values remain the same. isOriginal = FALSE.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up a crew member with non-original assignment on flight 124 HOU-DAL via a prior involuntary event
Flight 124 HOU-DAL, isOriginal=FALSE, changeType=Involuntary
Crew member is set up as non-original crew on flight 124 HOU-DAL
Apply an involuntary flight number change by scheduler on the same route HOU-DAL with same planned times
Flight number change on HOU-DAL route, times unchanged, changeType=Involuntary
Flight number change is applied successfully with only the flight number modified
Navigate to COA Search App and retrieve the COA record for the crew member
COA Search App - search by crew ID and trip
COA record is retrieved successfully
Verify the Actual Flight shows 124 HOU-DAL with the flight number change applied
Actual Flight field in COA record
Actual Flight: 124 HOU-DAL is present
Verify the COA Flight shows N/A because the leg is non-original
COA Flight field in COA record
COA Flight: N/A
Verify LCO eligibility status is not applicable for this flight number change scenario
LCO field in COA record
LCO: Not Applicable. Flight number change only does not trigger LCO.
